concept.title: Help on every page
concept.shortdesc: Press ? beside the notification bell to open the help panel. It is on every page you reach signed in, workspace settings, Runs and What's new included. It shows the page of this manual for what you are doing, written for the release your workspace is on, so what it describes matches what you see:

ul.li: It follows what you are doing. The panel opens on the topic for the screen you are on, and goes further where the manual does: the tab of a settings page, the step of a guided definition, a dialog such as citing evidence or downloading a project. Open a dialog with the panel open and it turns to the dialog's topic; close the dialog and it turns back.

Small ? buttons beside section headings, dialog titles and empty pages open the panel at that part of the manual: coverage, gaps and test runs on the V&V page, a requirement's quality findings, the traceability matrix, a board card.
From the keyboard, press ? anywhere you are not typing, or F1, to open help for what is on screen.

conbody.p: Links between pages open in the panel, Back returns, and the search box at the top searches the whole manual. Open in the docs opens the same page on the docs site and Full manual the docs site's front page, each in a new tab and at the release your workspace is on; a menu there lets you read the manual for other releases.
